examples.arabic: في النهاية انا بشرب شاي الصبح مع جدي عشان نحل المشكلة
examples.english: In the end I drink tea in the morning with my grandpa to solve the problem.
examples.transliteration: Fel nehaya ana bashrab shay el sobh maa geddi ashan nehel el moshkela.

examples.english: Little Karim's questions have no end.
examples.transliteration: As'elet Karim el soghayyar malhash nehaya
